content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview Selected candidates are required to make their own accommodation arrangements Desirable: Proven experience with AI for classifying biological datasets Experience in Designing, training, and validating AI/ML architectures Experience in maintaining rigorous code repositories (GitHub/GitLab) Experience in omics data analysis areas (single-cell and bulk RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, spatial omics, proteomics, metabolomics, genomics, imaging data, or clinical data)

rows.qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science; Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship and GATE

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Health Informatics, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field; M.Tech. with first class or equivalent and six years of relevant experience. Experience required: 6 years of relevant experience for M.Tech holders. Pay: ₹77,152 per month (inclusive of HRA). Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science; Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship and GATE. Experience required: 2 years research experience. Pay: ₹53,340 pm (inclusive of HRA).

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates In-person interview at ICGEB, New Delhi In-person interview at ICGEB, New Delhi for shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICGEB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Get the application form: https://apexbtic.icgeb.res.in/btisnet/adv-oct-2026-submission/. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Apply on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Only selected candidates will be informed individually

faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Sr. Project Scientist, 1 Sr. Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹77,152 per month (inclusive of HRA) for Sr. Project Scientist, ₹53,340 pm (inclusive of HRA) for Sr. Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview. Selected candidates are required to make their own accommodation arrangements.
